description_en: Retrieves the OAuth authorization URL required for the current user to bind a Lark account. After the user completes the authorization, the system automatically binds their Lark account
description_zh: 获取当前用户绑定飞书账号所需的 OAuth 授权链接。用户完成授权后，系统自动绑定其飞书账号
name: GetMyAgenticNotificationChannelAuthorizeUrl

parameters.help_en: The notification channel type. Currently, only FEISHU (the Chinese version of Lark) is supported. Specifying other values results in a parameter error
parameters.help_zh: 通知渠道类型。当前仅支持 FEISHU（飞书国内版），传入其他值会返回参数错误
parameters.name: channel

AuthorizeUrl.description_en: The URL of the Lark OAuth authorization page. After the user opens the URL in a browser and completes the authorization, the system binds the Lark account as the notification identity for the current user, and the channel switch remains unchanged. The state parameter in the URL is valid for 180 seconds and can be used only once
AuthorizeUrl.description_zh: 飞书 OAuth 授权页地址。用户在浏览器中打开并完成授权后，系统将该飞书账号绑定为当前用户的通知身份，渠道开关保持不变。链接中的 state 有效期为 180 秒，且只能使用一次

RedirectUri.description_en: The callback URL after the authorization is completed. You must add this URL to the redirect URL whitelist of the tenant's Lark application. Otherwise, the authorization fails
RedirectUri.description_zh: 授权完成后的回调地址。需将该地址添加到租户飞书应用的重定向 URL 白名单中，否则授权会失败

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。取值：true 表示成功，false 表示失败
